info.name: PyTorch keyword spotting classifier (ExecuTorch)
info.description: A PyTorch keyword-spotting classifier for audio data. Pairs with an MFE or MFCC processing block, reshapes the flattened spectrogram back into a (frames x coefficients) image, trains a compact 2D CNN, and exports an ONNX model for the platform plus an optional ExecuTorch .pte program for native PyTorch on-device inference.

parameters.name: Number of training epochs
parameters.help: Number of passes over the training set.

parameters.name: Learning rate
parameters.help: Learning rate for the Adam optimizer.

parameters.name: Batch size
parameters.help: Number of samples per gradient update.

parameters.name: Feature columns per frame
parameters.help: Number of coefficients per audio frame, used to reshape the flat feature vector into a (frames x columns) spectrogram. Set to the MFE filter number (40 by default) or the MFCC coefficient count (13 by default). The total feature count must be divisible by this value.

parameters.name: Export ExecuTorch .pte
parameters.help: Also export an ExecuTorch program (model.pte) alongside the ONNX model. The .pte is not used by the Edge Impulse SDK but is handy for native PyTorch/ExecuTorch deployment.
